scenario: Mobile refresh tokens are persisted in plaintext local stores and can be restored through backup paths.

android.backup_config: android:allowBackup="true" with no dataExtractionRules exclusion for shared_prefs/session.xml

ios.backup_config: default UserDefaults backup behavior, no Keychain item, no ThisDeviceOnly attribute

expected_findings.message: Refresh token is stored outside Android Keystore or iOS Keychain protections.
Secret-bearing preference storage is included in backup or restore paths.
No logout or compromise workflow evidence deletes and revokes the persisted refresh token.

non_goals: Do not report the literal token value.
Do not treat normal non-secret feature flags as findings.
